7806.name: Dermatitis or eczema
7806.formula: General Rating Formula For The Skin
7806.dc_cite: 7806 Dermatitis or eczema. Evaluate under the General Rating Formula for the Skin

factors.label: the percent of the entire body affected

bands.cite: Characteristic lesions involving less than 5 percent of the entire body affected
Characteristic lesions involving at least 5 percent, but less than 20 percent, of the entire body affected
Characteristic lesions involving 20 to 40 percent of the entire body
Characteristic lesions involving more than 40 percent of the entire body

factors.not_met: Records show about {value}% of the entire body affected.
factors.not_documented: Records do not document {label}. Ask your provider to document {label} as it is now.

factors.label: the percent of exposed areas affected

bands.cite: Characteristic lesions involving less than 5 percent of exposed areas affected
At least 5 percent, but less than 20 percent, of exposed areas affected
20 to 40 percent of exposed areas affected
more than 40 percent of exposed areas affected

factors.not_met: Records show about {value}% of exposed areas affected.
factors.not_documented: Records do not document {label}. Ask your provider to document {label} as it is now.

factors.label: the type and duration of treatment over the past 12 months

bands.cite: No more than topical therapy required over the past 12-month period

Intermittent systemic therapy including, but not limited to, corticosteroids, phototherapy, retinoids, biologics, photochemotherapy, PUVA, or other immunosuppressive drugs required for a total duration of less than 6 weeks over the past 12-month period

Systemic therapy including, but not limited to, corticosteroids, phototherapy, retinoids, biologics, photochemotherapy, PUVA, or other immunosuppressive drugs required for a total duration of 6 weeks or more, but not constantly, over the past 12-month period

Constant or near-constant systemic therapy including, but not limited to, corticosteroids, phototherapy, retinoids, biologics, photochemotherapy, psoralen with long-wave ultraviolet-A light (PUVA), or other immunosuppressive drugs required over the past 12-month period

factors.not_met: Records show {value} treatment. The next level depends on the type and duration of treatment; ask your provider whether other treatment options fit your condition.
factors.not_documented: Records do not document {label}. Ask your provider to document {label} as it is now.

factors.label: recurrent tinnitus

bands.cite: Tinnitus, recurrent

5237.name: Lumbosacral or cervical strain (thoracolumbar criteria only)
5237.formula: General Rating Formula for Diseases and Injuries of the Spine

factors.label: a forward flexion measurement of the thoracolumbar spine (lower back range of motion)

bands.cite: Forward flexion of the thoracolumbar spine greater than 60 degrees but not greater than 85 degrees
Forward flexion of the thoracolumbar spine greater than 30 degrees but not greater than 60 degrees
forward flexion of the thoracolumbar spine 30 degrees or less

factors.not_met: Records show forward flexion of about {value} degrees.
factors.not_documented: Records do not document {label}. Ask your provider to document {label} as it is now.

factors.label: the combined range of motion of the thoracolumbar spine

bands.cite: combined range of motion of the thoracolumbar spine greater than 120 degrees but not greater than 235 degrees
the combined range of motion of the thoracolumbar spine not greater than 120 degrees

factors.not_met: Records show a combined range of motion of about {value} degrees.
factors.not_documented: Records do not document {label}. Ask your provider to document {label} as it is now.

factors.label: whether muscle spasm, guarding, or tenderness is present and whether it affects gait or spinal contour

bands.cite: muscle spasm, guarding, or localized tenderness not resulting in abnormal gait or abnormal spinal contour
muscle spasm or guarding severe enough to result in an abnormal gait or abnormal spinal contour such as scoliosis, reversed lordosis, or abnormal kyphosis

factors.not_documented: Records do not document {label}. Ask your provider to document {label} as it is now.

factors.label: whether there is ankylosis (fixation) of the spine

bands.cite: favorable ankylosis of the entire thoracolumbar spine
Unfavorable ankylosis of the entire thoracolumbar spine
Unfavorable ankylosis of the entire spine

factors.not_documented: Records do not document {label}. Ask your provider to document {label} as it is now.
